exercise.name: Seated Cable Rear Delt Fly
library_steps: Sit on a bench between two low pulleys and lean your chest forward.
Hold each handle in the opposite hand, cables crossing in front of your legs.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
exercise.one_line_summary: Seated on a bench end leaning ~45 deg forward over the thighs, each hand holding the handle from the opposite low pulley so the cables cross in front of the legs; the softly bent arms rise from under the chest out to the sides at shoulder height. Rear delts do the work, the middle trapezius/rhomboids help.

setup.target: Both low, out to the sides and forward of the feet.

movement.end: out to the sides at shoulder height

muscles.emg: Horizontal abduction (arm moving out and back) gave among the highest posterior deltoid activity (S1).
muscles.role: Pulls the arm out and back; what the exercise is for.

muscles.emg: Shoulder horizontal extension gave the highest middle-trapezius EMG of 10 exercises (S2).
muscles.role: Draws the shoulder blades together; library secondary.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Trunk rises as the arms lift.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Keeps the work off the rear delts.

sources.citation: Reinold MM, Wilk KE, Fleisig GS, et al. 2004. Electromyographic analysis of the rotator cuff and deltoid musculature during common shoulder external rotation exercises. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther 34(7):385-394.
sources.what_it_gave: Prone horizontal abduction (arm moving out and back at shoulder height) gave among the highest posterior deltoid activity of the exercises tested.

sources.citation: Ekstrom RA, Donatelli RA, Soderberg GL. 2003. Surface electromyographic analysis of exercises for the trapezius and serratus anterior muscles. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther 33(5):247-258.
sources.what_it_gave: 10 exercises, 30 subjects: the shrug gave the highest upper-trapezius EMG; shoulder horizontal extension (arm moving back at shoulder height) the highest middle trapezius; the prone overhead raise in a Y the highest lower trapezius.

clip_check.check: Start: hands under the chest, cables crossing
End: arms out at shoulder height
Both fists closed on the handles; cables clear of the legs
